data.name: Phase Line Red
data.detailed_description:
Command. Execute. Review. Phase Line Red is a hardcore, turn-based tactical WW2 wargame built around a simultaneous execution (WEGO) system.


Control and Command Realistic control and command dynamics make every decision matter, as you struggle the chaos of the battlefield.

The Fog of War Information is your most valuable weapon. Use your scout elements to probe the frontline before committing your main armor assets to a blind advance.

Cinematic Replay System Post-turn analysis is just as important as command input. Every WEGO turn is captured frame-by-frame.

Endless Tactical Depth Whether you are playing a quick battle, diving into the campaign flow, playing hotseat multiplayer, or using the integrated editor to build your own scenarios, Phase Line Red offers a rich sandbox of combined-arms tactics.

data.short_description: Take command in Phase Line Red, a WEGO turn-based tactical wargame. Plan company-level operations, issue orders to your platoons, and watch the chaos of WW2 combat unfold in thrilling, simultaneous cinematic replays. Master the fog of war and push the frontline forward.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent (Quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 460 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
